# Support

## Getting Help

If you need help with ShellFromBrowser, here are your options:

### Bug Reports

If you've found a bug, please [open an issue](https://github.com/valorisa/ShellFromBrowser/issues/new/choose) using the bug report template. Include as much detail as possible to help us reproduce and fix the issue.

### Feature Requests

Have an idea for a new feature? [Open a feature request](https://github.com/valorisa/ShellFromBrowser/issues/new/choose) and tell us about it.

### Questions and Discussions

For general questions, usage help, or discussions about the project:
- Check the [README](../README.md) for documentation
- Visit [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/valorisa/ShellFromBrowser/discussions)

### Security Issues

If you discover a security vulnerability, please DO NOT open a public issue. Instead, please contact the maintainers directly at security@example.com (or through GitHub Security Advisories).

## Contributing

Interested in contributing? Check out our [Contributing Guidelines](../CONTRIBUTING.md) to get started.
